scope: Image and repeated-label pilot; no semantic key assumed
selection_reason: purposive coverage of prose, herbs, circular diagrams, zodiac, bath diagrams, plant-fragment labels and marginalia; not a random representative sample
candidate_rule: single clean alphabetic labels of at least 3 EVA characters, exact agreement at the same locus between ZL and IT, repeated on at least two pages; sort by occurrence count then alphabetical; first 10
independence_warning: transcriptions share a physical source and can share conventions; their agreement is not ground truth
label_prose_test: plant-fragment and container labels versus prose on same pharmaceutical page, compared with 10000 permutations of whole label-page blocks; replicate in ZL and IT
meaning_rule: No meanings inferred from diagram identity alone. Observed categories are spatial relations, not translations.
images: Exact crops only. No synthetic restoration. Coordinates in full-resolution Yale canvas pixels.
new_software_scope: No full TranscriptTool installation, no joint phonetic decoder in this phase.
